name: DiffusionGemma 26B
notes: Diffusion (dLLM) variant on a Gemma 4 MoE backbone: a bidirectional decoder mode with Uniform-State Diffusion generates a block of tokens in parallel and refines it over a few denoising steps (shared weights with an encoder/causal mode that warms the KV cache). lucebox serves it via DiffusionBackend over the existing gemma4 graph. The `diffusion`/`sampling` blocks below are engineering starting points for the diffusion decoder, NOT a verbatim transcription of the upstream card — verify against the source before production use.
